team_hypothesis: An extreme completed funding payment, same-direction pre-settlement price extension and mark-index premium identify a crowded side. Trade only the first verified post-settlement reversal and premium compression; do not predict or capture the triggering funding payment.

listing_policy.ETHUSDT: configured archive lower bound 2019-11-29; actual first common bar is detected and reported
listing_policy.DOGEUSDT: configured archive lower bound 2020-07-10 09:00 UTC; actual first common bar is detected and reported
listing_policy.SOLUSDT: configured archive lower bound 2020-09-14 07:00 UTC; actual first common bar is detected and reported
listing_policy.SUIUSDT: launched 2023-05-03 16:00 UTC; all earlier periods are N/A, not missing data or zero performance
listing_policy.eligibility: Each symbol must accumulate its own 180 earlier realized funding observations. History is never borrowed from another symbol and common evaluation windows are not shifted for SUI.

data.access: Anonymous public Binance data only; no account, API key, private file or application
data.missing_policy: No interpolation or forward-fill. A missing bar in an event, open position or rolling threshold window invalidates that event. Duplicate or non-causal funding timestamps fail the affected replay.
data.rolling_statistics: Every threshold excludes the classified funding event and all later observations. Minimum history is 180 earlier funding events per symbol.
data.funding_timestamp: Preserve raw calc_time for audit, then ceil to the first 5m boundary at or after calc_time, never floor. A duplicate after normalization is a hard data error.

event_at_completed_funding_T.funding_extreme: abs(funding[T]) >= max(0.0005, trailing Q95 of abs(funding) over the prior 180 events)
event_at_completed_funding_T.price_extension: 60m perpetual close return through the bar ending at T has the same sign as funding and abs(return) >= trailing Q80 of abs 60m event returns over the prior 180 funding events
event_at_completed_funding_T.premium: mark/index - 1 at the final completed pre-T bar has the same sign as funding and abs(premium) >= 0.0003
event_at_completed_funding_T.deduplication: One immutable setup id per symbol and funding timestamp

confirmation_and_entry.confirmation_time: At T+5m, after the first complete post-settlement 5m bar
confirmation_and_entry.reversal: Return from the last pre-T close to the first post-T close has the opposite sign to funding
confirmation_and_entry.entry: Market at the open of the next 5m bar: positive funding => short, negative funding => long
confirmation_and_entry.portfolio_collision: At most one global position. If multiple events qualify, maximize abs(funding)/funding_threshold + abs(return60)/return_threshold + abs(pre_premium)/0.0003 + (1 - abs(post_premium/pre_premium)); ties SUI, DOGE, XRP, SOL, ETH.

position_management.R: max(2 * Wilder ATR(14) from completed 5m bars, 0.0040 * entry_price)
position_management.cost_breakeven: After a completed 5m bar first reaches +1R, activate from the next bar a stop intended to leave +2 bps net after the full stress round trip; gaps and slippage may still make the realized result negative
position_management.maximum_holding_time: 180 minutes, then market at the next 5m open
position_management.intrabar_policy: If stop and target are both possible in one bar, stop executes first. A gap through stop fills at the worse of bar open or stop, plus adverse slippage.
position_management.funding: The settlement at T belongs to the pre-entry market and is excluded. Any later settlement while the position is open is booked with the correct long/short sign.

capital_and_risk.risk_per_trade: min(0.50 USD, 0.20% of min(current equity, 250 USD)), inclusive of stress exit costs
capital_and_risk.portfolio_drawdown_kill: 4.00% from high-water mark; permanent RISK_FAIL for that replay window
capital_and_risk.order_quantization: Round quantity down to the symbol MARKET_LOT_SIZE and stop/target prices adversely to tick size. Use a conservative $20 minimum notional for every symbol because historical filter changes are not fully available. Reject a smaller order; never increase size or risk to meet the minimum.
capital_and_risk.liquidity_gate: Order notional must be <=0.10% of the minimum perpetual quote volume among the prior 12 fully completed 5m bars.

windows.genuine_oos: first complete UTC day after implementation and code-hash freeze

historical_gate: development: >=40 trades, stress PF >=1.20 and stress net >0
validation: >=25 trades, stress PF >=1.10 and stress net >0
retrospective evaluation: >=25 trades, stress PF >=1.10 and stress net >0
validation plus evaluation: lower 95% UTC-week block-bootstrap bound of mean trade PnL >0
stress maximum drawdown <=4% and no risk/collateral violation
long and short trades each >=20% of all trades
at least 3 symbols each have >=5 validation-plus-evaluation trades and positive stress net
no symbol supplies >40% of trades or positive stress gross PnL
after removing any one symbol, combined validation-plus-evaluation stress net remains >0 and PF >=1.00

income_target_gate.target: 25 USD average net per calendar day on 250 USD initial capital
income_target_gate.calculation: stress net PnL divided by every calendar day in the window, including no-trade days
income_target_gate.required: validation and retrospective evaluation must each average >=25 USD/day and the lower 95% UTC-week block-bootstrap bound of mean daily PnL must also be >=25 USD/day
income_target_gate.separate_decision: Report EDGE_PASS/FAIL independently from INCOME_TARGET_PASS/FAIL. Never increase risk after seeing the result.

ai_role: After deterministic qualification, an AI ensemble may label APPROVE/REJECT in shadow only. Its cohort must prospectively beat the identical deterministic baseline over at least 100 candidates before any execution role is reconsidered.
promotion: A historical pass authorizes only paper-forward. Live consideration requires >=40 prospective trades over >=6 months, stress-equivalent PF >=1.20, positive lower bootstrap bound, drawdown <=4% and no protocol mutation.
goal_reality: No result may be described as guaranteeing $25/day. On $250 that target is 10% per day and cannot be made credible by sizing or leverage.
